description: Aggregates a token's price across multiple chains and venues (DEX + CEX) into one comparable read, flagging the highest-deviation pair. Settlement proof: ProofOfSettledOutcome (kind 30120, data/proof_settled_outcomes.jsonl). Narrower than oracle.comprehensive-report (single metric, not a full report); feeds oracle.market-arbitrage's spread detection. (x402: $0.03 USDC per call)
name: oracle.cross-chain-prices
